node.statement: Apply lem-maincb-improvement-iteration with B=B_R, A=A_R, epsilon=epsilon_R, d=D*t, and v=u_R. Its single output is a map v_R:B_R->A_R having exactly the amplification family (v_R)_n=I_n tensor v_R, displacement sup_n ||(v_R)_n-(u_R)_n|| <= K_disp*D*t, and extended-inclusion defect K_floor*epsilon_R.
